_readme: sha256 of the engine archives this project builds against, keyed <os>-<arch>.
Scripts read it via scripts/fetch_engine.sh; a mismatch is a build failure, not a warning.
Xray publishes a .dgst per asset, so its digest is always verifiable upstream. sing-box
publishes none at all, which is exactly why pinning belongs here: a supply-chain swap of
an engine binary is otherwise invisible in the build log.
To (re)generate on a network you trust:
then commit the file. Deliberately shipped empty: a placeholder hash is worse than none,
because it fails the build for the wrong reason and teaches people to delete the check.
